name: Ragi Chocolate Lava Cake
short_description: Molten dark chocolate center with finger millet flour and date sweetness
description: A warm, indulgent lava cake made with nutrient-rich ragi (finger millet) flour and naturally sweetened with Medjool dates and a touch of monk fruit. The molten dark chocolate center is pure 85% cacao — no refined sugar, no maida, all flavor.
recipe_steps: Melt dark chocolate with coconut oil over a double boiler
Blend soaked dates into a smooth paste
Whisk eggs until fluffy, fold in date paste
Sift ragi flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder together
Fold dry ingredients into wet, then fold in melted chocolate
Pour into greased ramekins, bake at 200°C for 12-14 minutes
Center should be molten — serve immediately

name: Almond Flour Gulab Jamun
short_description: Soft, syrup-soaked dumplings made with almond flour and date syrup
description: Traditional gulab jamun reimagined with almond flour instead of maida, soaked in a warm date syrup infused with cardamom and rose water. All the nostalgia, none of the refined sugar.
recipe_steps: Crumble khoya finely, mix with almond flour
Add a pinch of baking soda, knead into smooth dough
Roll into small, crack-free balls
Deep fry in ghee on low heat until deep golden
Warm date syrup with cardamom, rose water, and saffron
Soak fried jamuns in warm syrup for at least 2 hours
Serve warm with a strand of saffron

name: Coconut Millet Kheer
short_description: Creamy foxtail millet pudding with coconut milk and jaggery
description: A light, aromatic kheer made with foxtail millet cooked in coconut milk and sweetened with unrefined jaggery. Garnished with toasted cashews and cardamom — comfort in a bowl.
recipe_steps: Wash and soak foxtail millet for 30 minutes
Dry roast millet lightly until fragrant
Simmer in coconut milk on low heat, stirring often
Add grated jaggery once millet is cooked and creamy
Toast cashews in a drop of ghee
Garnish with cardamom, saffron, and toasted cashews
Serve warm or chilled

name: Pistachio Oat Barfi
short_description: Rich pistachio fudge squares with oat flour and date sweetness
description: Dense, aromatic barfi made with ground pistachios, oat flour, and naturally sweetened with date paste. Topped with slivers of pistachio and edible silver leaf.
recipe_steps: Grind pistachios to a fine powder, keep some coarse for texture
Heat ghee, add oat flour, and roast until golden and fragrant
Add pistachio powder, stir continuously
Add warm milk gradually, cook until thick
Mix in date paste and cardamom, cook until mixture leaves the sides
Spread in a greased tray, top with pistachio slivers
Cool, cut into diamond shapes

name: Stevia Mango Cheesecake
short_description: No-bake mango cheesecake with an almond flour crust and stevia
description: A luscious no-bake cheesecake with Alphonso mango purée, cream cheese, and a nutty almond flour crust. Sweetened purely with stevia — tastes like summer with zero sugar.
recipe_steps: Mix almond flour with melted coconut oil and a pinch of stevia
Press into a springform pan base, freeze for 20 minutes
Beat cream cheese until smooth
Fold in mango pulp, stevia, and vanilla
Pour over set crust, smooth the top
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours
Top with fresh mango slices and toasted coconut

name: Date-Walnut Brownie
short_description: Fudgy brownies with whole wheat, walnuts, and Medjool date sweetness
description: A rich, fudgy brownie made with whole wheat flour and loaded with walnuts. Sweetened entirely with Medjool dates — deeply chocolatey with zero added sugar.
recipe_steps: Soak dates in warm water, blend into a smooth paste
Melt coconut oil, mix with date paste
Whisk eggs, fold into the date-oil mixture
Sift whole wheat flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder
Fold dry into wet, add chopped walnuts
Pour into a parchment-lined pan
Bake at 175°C for 22-25 minutes — slightly underdone is perfect

name: Coconut Flour Banana Bread
short_description: Moist banana bread with coconut flour and natural coconut sugar
description: Perfectly moist banana bread made with coconut flour and naturally sweetened with ripe bananas and a touch of coconut sugar. High in fiber, low in guilt.
recipe_steps: Mash ripe bananas until smooth
Whisk eggs, mix in mashed banana and melted coconut oil
Add coconut sugar, vanilla, and cinnamon
Sift coconut flour and baking soda, fold gently into wet mix
Let batter rest 5 minutes (coconut flour absorbs slowly)
Pour into a greased loaf pan
Bake at 165°C for 45-50 minutes until a skewer comes out clean

name: Ragi Ladoo (Protein)
short_description: Energy-packed ladoos with ragi, oats, jaggery, and dry fruits
description: Nutrient-dense ladoos made with roasted ragi flour and oat flour, bound with melted jaggery and packed with dry fruits. A guilt-free snack that's also a protein bomb.
recipe_steps: Dry roast ragi flour on low heat until fragrant (10 mins)
Dry roast oat flour separately until golden
Chop almonds and cashews finely
Melt jaggery with ghee on low heat
Mix all dry ingredients into the jaggery-ghee mixture
Shape into balls while warm
Roll in desiccated coconut

name: Allulose Rasmalai
short_description: Soft paneer discs in saffron-cardamom cream, sweetened with allulose
description: Cloud-soft paneer discs soaked in a fragrant allulose-sweetened cream infused with saffron, cardamom, and rose. Traditional rasmalai flavor with virtually zero caloric sweetener.
recipe_steps: Knead paneer until very smooth and crack-free
Shape into flat discs, set aside
Reduce milk to 2/3 volume on low heat, stirring constantly
Add allulose, saffron, and cardamom to reduced milk
Gently simmer paneer discs in sweetened milk for 10 minutes
Cool and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
Serve chilled, topped with sliced pistachios and almonds

name: Foxtail Millet Payasam
short_description: South Indian milk pudding with foxtail millet and date sweetness
description: A traditional South Indian payasam made with foxtail millet, slow-cooked in milk, and sweetened with dates. Finished with roasted cashews and a whisper of cardamom.
recipe_steps: Wash foxtail millet, dry roast lightly
Cook millet in water until soft, drain excess
Boil milk and reduce by a third
Blend soaked dates into a smooth paste
Add cooked millet and date paste to reduced milk
Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes, stirring
Roast cashews in ghee, use as garnish with cardamom and coconut
